description.zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must match the AppName of the live stream to be transferred for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
转推的第三方直播地址，最多支持添加1个地址。

>目标地址协议必须和转推的直播流协议一致，目前仅支持RTMP和SRT协议的转推地址。
description.en:
The third-party live streaming address to transfer to. A maximum of one address is supported.

>The protocol of the destination address must match the protocol of the live stream being transferred. Only RTMP and SRT protocols are supported.

description.zh:
转推结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

>结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

>The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
转推开始时间。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
转推有效时间。取值：

- **always**：永久生效。

- **time**：指定时间内有效。

>取值为**time**时，**StartTime**和**EndTime**必填。
description.en:
The transfer validity period. Valid values:

- **always**: Permanently effective.

- **time**: Effective within a specified time range.

>If you set this parameter to **time**, **StartTime** and **EndTime** are required.

title.zh: 修改直播中心转推配置

descriptions.zh:
本接口仅支持修改**转推有效时间**（TransferArgs、StartTime、EndTime）相关配置
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。、
descriptions.en:
This operation only supports updating configurations related to the **transfer validity period** (TransferArgs, StartTime, EndTime).
## QPS limit
The QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testapp --stream-name teststream --dst-url rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2 --transfer-args always --start-time 2017-12-21T10:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateLiveCenterTransfer --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName teststream --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TransferArgs always --StartTime '2017-12-21T10:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DstUrl 'rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2' --AppName testapp
